newsitem.title: GERMANY: German air passenger travel grows 2.1 pct in Oct.
newsitem.headline: German air passenger travel grows 2.1 pct in Oct.

text.p: German airline passenger numbers rose 2.1 percent to 11.0 million in October, figures from the German airports authority ADV showed.

The total number of passengers passing through the county's 16 international airports has grown 2.6 percent to 97.3 million over the first ten months of 1996, the latest ADV monthly traffic report said.
Domestic air passenger numbers rose 1.3 percent to 3.1 million in October but are showing a 0.9 percent year-on-year fall to 28.7 million passengers.
European travel grew 3.1 percent to 5.88 million journeys last month and has increased 5.4 percent to 51.16 million over the first ten months.

Travel to overseas destinations rose 1.7 percent to 1.77 million journeys in October and has grown 1.4 percent to 15.7 million passengers from January-October. -- Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
